description: This file defines the interface DDataReader, which provides methods for reading distributed Bloom filters of subscribed topics and associated data in an Akka-based distributed system. It includes methods for fetching subscribers, reading low-level maps, mapping topics to distributed data keys, subscribing to change events, and retrieving the data key.

classes.name: DDataReader
classes.description: Generic interface for reading distributed data related to topics, including subscriber retrieval, data reading, topic approximation, change event subscription, and key access.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the collection of ActorRef subscribers whose Bloom filters contain all hashes of the provided topic hashes.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a low-level map of ActorRef to set of topics from the local replicator asynchronously. Has a default implementation that reads from local data.

methods.name: read(Replicator.ReadConsistency)
methods.description: Reads a low-level map from the replicator with specified read consistency.

methods.name: approximate
methods.description: Provides a topic approximation in the distributed data, mapping a topic string to its distributed data representation.

methods.name: receiveChanges
methods.description: Subscribes the given ActorRef to receive distributed data change events.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the Akka distributed data key associated with this data reader.
